speckit.name: BrainBuddy Portable Spec Review
speckit.description: Portable full-path spec review gate (ADR-0011/ADR-0023): five read-only reviewer lenses fan out over planning artifacts and fan in to one schema-validated verdict. Runs only when an ADR-0023 full-path trigger applies, with or without a managed outcome; eligible fast-lane SHIP/SHOW work does not invoke it.
